works.body:
Hello sensei!! It's nice to meet you. I love your soft colors. I love this piece the most:
https://x.com/7ru_5/status/1956658871390634246?t=u5kxpEacz6gAWyFnYPPhCw&s=19
May I make a request?

✨️ Characters
[1] Quinn
Male. 168cm.
Quinn at first is not very kind, often cynical and critical of others while maintaining a sharp tongue. He keeps his walls up, and finds it hard to trust others. He pushes people away, finds it hard to care, but once he does care he is thoughtful and it is something he would find embarrassing. Cat-like. Smart. He is a healer / medic in most universes. Heterochromia eyes, one is lighter than the other. 

Healing + Resurrection magic. Tradeoff: loss of memory + physical corruption with each use. Scales to how much is healed or resurrected. He also likes flower pressing, and carries a journal to remember everything important to him.

[2] Alphard
Male. 170cm.
Alphard appears like a guy who only cares for profit. He doesn't get close to anyone except for work and parts his ways with others whenever the job is done. He likes to prove himself and brag about his greatness, making him seem like a narcissistic show off. Despite that, he cares greatly about other people and tries to minimize damages and puts great efforts keeping the group together during jobs. He is usually seen in the "default outfit". He has one blue eye and one yellow eye and the lights in his eyes look like sparkles.

Injuries transfer magic and healing magic. Alphard can only heal himself. In order to continue working as healer, he first transfers injuries to himself and then heals himself whenever he arrives at an inn.

✨️ Relationship
They are a couple, though at first, they didn't like each other. They love to playfully argue, but they also take good care of each other. Due to their similarities, they often feel like they are the only ones who are able to understand one another. They have both kept their distance from other people for so long, and as a result they do not know how to handle their emotions well, at times being shy around each other.

✨️References 
https://peapup.notion.site/quinoa-26a8ee95900280d99005cd1403e53953

Thank you for your consideration!
